libraryBackup.title: Backup & restore
libraryBackup.intro: Save your local content and learning progress to restore in another browser.
libraryBackup.size: Current raw backup data: about {{used}} MiB of the {{capacity}} MiB limit. Encoding makes the encrypted file larger.
libraryBackup.sizeWarning: Raw backup data is near its limit: {{used}} MiB of {{capacity}} MiB. Export a backup now and reduce large media before adding more data.
libraryBackup.detailText: Includes source material, conversations, meanings, learning resources and history. Sign-in credentials and API keys are excluded; reconnect custom services after restoring.
libraryBackup.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters. Keep this password: it cannot be recovered.
libraryBackup.restoreHint: Restore into an empty local library. Account backups also require the original account.
libraryBackup.exported: Backup created. Check that the downloaded file has been saved.
libraryBackup.restored: Library restored. Reopen the app to continue learning.
libraryBackup.restoredResourcesDeferred: Library restored, but local learning resources could not be refreshed. Reopen the app to retry; your restored data is preserved.
libraryBackup.summary: Sources: {{drafts}} · Meanings: {{meanings}} · Packages: {{packages}} · Learning items: {{targets}} · Runs: {{runs}} · Events: {{events}}
libraryBackup.interrupted: {{count}} unfinished requests will stop. Retry them manually after restoring.
libraryBackup.failed: The operation failed. Your existing content is unchanged. Please try again.
libraryBackup.tooLarge: Backup files must be smaller than 90 MiB.

support.aboutText: Start with a specific meaning, connect it with an expression, and build familiarity through learning and review.
support.privacyText: Content and learning progress are stored in this browser first. When you sign in, supported records are synchronized as the current account checkpoint; sync is not a versioned backup. Clearing website data removes local and unsynced records. Account deletion removes the server-side account copy, but offline copies in other browsers must be cleared on those devices.
support.providersText: A configured model provider receives the text or images required for the model request. The default client speech provider receives the text, language and selected voice needed to synthesize audio. Dictionary and YouGlish requests send the lookup query and ordinary network metadata to those services. Custom providers apply their own terms and retention policies.
support.retentionText: Short-lived semantic lookup payloads expire after 24 hours. Successful managed-model responses are retained for up to 6 hours and request metadata for up to 26 hours. The current cloud-sync checkpoint and account content remain until replaced or deleted. Encrypted backup files remain wherever you save them.
support.feedbackText: Contact support for product feedback, content corrections, account recovery, or deletion questions. Attach the diagnostic file only when it helps; it contains runtime state and counts, not learning content, email addresses, record identifiers, URLs, tokens, or stacks.
support.unavailable: Support contact details are currently unavailable.
support.diagnosticsText: Download a local JSON report with release, browser capability, storage, and sync state. Review it before attaching it to a support request.
support.diagnosticsFailed: Diagnostics could not be prepared. Contact support without an attachment.

dataControl.persistenceIntro: Sensa saves this library on this device. Stronger browser protection reduces automatic eviction risk, but it is not a backup and does not survive clearing site data.
dataControl.persistence_persistent: Protected from automatic storage eviction on this device.
dataControl.persistence_best-effort: Best-effort browser storage. The browser may evict this library under storage pressure.
dataControl.persistence_unsupported: This browser does not expose an additional storage-protection request.
dataControl.persistence_unavailable: Storage protection status is temporarily unavailable.
dataControl.storageBudget: Browser estimate for this site: {{used}} MiB of {{quota}} MiB used. This may also include app files.
dataControl.storageBudgetWarning: This site has used over 80% of its browser-estimated space: {{used}} MiB of {{quota}} MiB. Export a backup and free device space soon.
dataControl.clearIntro: Clear content, learning progress and model settings from this browser only. Your account is not deleted. Export a backup first if you want to keep this content.
dataControl.clearSummary: This removes {{drafts}} sources, {{meanings}} meanings, {{packages}} packages, {{targets}} learning items and {{events}} events.
dataControl.clearPending: There are {{count}} unfinished preparations. They cannot continue after erasure.
dataControl.clearDiscardPending: Discard these {{count}} unsynced account changes from this browser. They will not be added to the cloud copy.
dataControl.clearConfirm: I have saved any backup I need and confirm erasing this local content.
dataControl.clearDone: Local content cleared. Reopen the app to use the empty library.
